body: - Fixed issue with Macro Bar not disappearing completely when setting is enabled
- Updated to V14

- Fixed movement in HUD
- Removed translations
- Fixed tooltip scale
- Updated to AppV2
- Fixed some icons using outdated font
- Improved css to prevent tooltip subtitle wrapping

## What's Changed
* Added fallback size restriction on tooltips in case they somehow excede the screen size
* cs.json by @Lethrendis in https://github.com/theripper93/enhancedcombathud/pull/158

## New Contributors
* @Lethrendis made their first contribution in https://github.com/theripper93/enhancedcombathud/pull/158

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/theripper93/enhancedcombathud/compare/4.0.4...4.0.5
- Fixed target picker clear targets
- Fix colorsettings module check

- Added new theme "Foundry Dark" that matches the foundry dark mode
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/914714a7-a781-42b6-96c9-8cb6cc10e4f1)
- Colorsettings is now an optional dependency
- Updated to V13
- Switched rounding from floor to round in grid movement spaces calculations to better represent gridless movement
- Removed recomended install of dnd5e argon module from manifest

- Hud will now show temporary effects

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fb7ef32b-3ae4-4d5d-bfb7-4b912eaad80a)
- Closing the hud will now force all open tooltips to be closed
- Pass turn button is now correcty updating when a token's turn starts
- Added new defineTooltip method to define your own tooltip class
- Improved host compatibility for custom themes
- Fixed action items not beein hidden properly due to css specificity issue
- Switched distance measurement to `measurePath` which takes into consideration the diagonal rule
- V12 update
- Fixed rare issue that would crash the hud under specific circumnstances
- fix for previous fix
Fixed issue where accordion items could fail to set their initial state correctly
- Range rings now correctly take token size into consideration

## What's Changed
* Allow undo for movementHUD by @Saibot393 in https://github.com/theripper93/enhancedcombathud/pull/153


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/theripper93/enhancedcombathud/compare/2.5.10...2.5.11
- Player details now use the main color theme as a background instead of the main color

## What's Changed
* Transmit token update context to movement hud onTokenUpdate by @Saibot393 in https://github.com/theripper93/enhancedcombathud/pull/150


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/theripper93/enhancedcombathud/compare/2.5.8...2.5.9
- added `tooltipCls` on `ArgonComponent`
- Added new `ARGON.PREFAB.MacroPanel`, a premade panel that will mirror the macro hotbars
- Fixed visual bug in weapon sets selection caused by recent chromium update

- Changed method with which players\macros\fps are hidden to avoid layout shift
- API: All tooltip properties are now parsed as html

## What's Changed
* Movement color as property by @Saibot393 in https://github.com/theripper93/enhancedcombathud/pull/145
* Accordion subpanel customisation by @Saibot393 in https://github.com/theripper93/enhancedcombathud/pull/147


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/theripper93/enhancedcombathud/compare/2.5.3...2.5.4

## What's Changed
* Tooltips can now be locked with middle mouse button
* Patch 1 by @Kariaudhanaur in https://github.com/theripper93/enhancedcombathud/pull/143

## New Contributors
* @Kariaudhanaur made their first contribution in https://github.com/theripper93/enhancedcombathud/pull/143

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/theripper93/enhancedcombathud/compare/2.5.2...2.5.3
- Added hooks for custom argon componenets
- Fix to circumvent foundry bug where "combatStart" hook is fired only on the client starting the combat
- Starting a new target picker workflow, cancels an active one if present

## What's Changed
* pt-BR translation by @ricarthlima in https://github.com/theripper93/enhancedcombathud/pull/142

## New Contributors
* @ricarthlima made their first contribution in https://github.com/theripper93/enhancedcombathud/pull/142

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/theripper93/enhancedcombathud/compare/2.4.9...2.4.9.1
- removed debugger
- Fixed movement hud calculation logic in the event that values are Zero or Null
- Added setting to Suppress warnings (such as the actor not supported one)

- Fixed issue with drawer panel crashing when deslecting a token with the panel open
- Fixed Player details on bottom making the details invisible
- Adjustet content link stile in tooltips for better visibility
- Added new apis to make multiple drawer panels possible
- More small fixes to the css refactor
- Fixed quantity triangle color missing from refactor
- Fixed style on the new button hud logic

- Added new ButtonHud API, a replacement for the MovementHud when out of combat or when the system does not track movement
- Refactored CSS into SCSS for better scoping to avoid class name collisions
